note: generated by tools/make_token_inventory.py from the style index; one row per colour token (a token whose reference value resolves to one colour). 'rules' counts the (sheet, selector, property) triples painted through the token, following aliases. Crimson overrides are the tokens the crimson preset overrides.

crimson_roles.note: second source for S4's role map: what the crimson preset (proven in game in its bundle form) gave each overridden colour token. 'ramp' and 'palette_entry' come from matching the output colour against the preset's own palette (crimson.py); 'preset_note' is the preset's own comment (a design-guide section and the rule applied); 'role' is INFERRED from the token's name by the ordered rules in ROLE_RULES, and 'role_rule' is the rule that fired.
